items.q: Where do the businesses come from?
items.a: From Google Maps. You search by industry and area and Leadta brings back businesses with the public details on their listing.

items.q: Do leads always have a phone and email?
items.a: No. If Google Maps or the business's website doesn't publish a detail, the cell stays empty. We never fill gaps with made-up data.
Leadta analyzes each business's saved reviews, and every finding quotes the review behind it. With no readable reviews, there are no findings.

items.q: How many leads does a plan give me?
items.a: Each lead uses 2 credits. With 500 credits you get up to 250 leads, and pain point analysis adds 0.5 credits per analyzed lead.

items.q: Can I repeat a search in the same area?
items.a: Yes. Leadta remembers the businesses it already returned for that area so later searches bring you new results.
Yes. Every account has its own history, and nobody else sees your batches or leads.
